name: Essence of Delirium
description: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier
directions: Right click this item then left click a Rare item to apply it.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a Rare item to apply it.
keywordDefinition: A monster empowered by an Essence of Delirium will periodically summon the demons that lay behind the Delirium Mirror.
